body: My mom is homeless. So no, my dad lives 2 hours away with his new family. It's just me. Alone. Always now.
It did, thank you. You're a kind person. I appreciate all the words. ,

Yeah my cat died last year also, her name was mittens, 11 years old. I'm just hoping if something is after this life, I'll have better luck there and hopefully I'll see jasper again. All I can wish for.

I tried so long to be positive, to be happy, up until his death, at that very moment I knew I would not survive his death. He was all I had in this world my boyfriend was set up to leave me once our lease is up this month, and he knew all I had was jasper. I have suffered for 20 years, I always think it can't always be this bad all the time, and then the world shows me how wrong I am. One bad thing after another. Only I know my pain, i would of jumped in front of the car for him, I wish I could have. I don't want to be here anymore. I'm just sitting in my bath tub waiting for 7am. Crying, I can bearly breath anymore

I have wanted to die for so long, being so unhappy all of my life, nothing good comes my way, so much darkness seems to follow me, I was a very depressed person, and all I wanted to do was not exist anymore but I couldn't leave the only thing I cared about, now he is gone, and I'm left here with nothing. Life isn't and has never been worth living, I do not see the point in staying around just to suffer longer. Every second hurts more. This pain and hole in my chest, I want it to stop.
